Senior Director of Operations & Supply Chain (CPG) Job Description
About the Position |Major goals and objectives and location requirements:
We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Operations Director to build and lead end-to-end operations for a new CPG beverage brand. You will own the physical life cycle of the product-from commercialization and sourcing through production, inventory, warehousing, shipping, and replenishment. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and manufacturing partners to ensure we make the right product, at the right quality and cost, and get it where it needs to go on time. • Own inventory, warehousing, fulfillment and transportation across retail, distributor, foodservice and DTC channels.

• Own key components of COGS and landed cost , while managing operational KPIs across production, inventory, service, freight and cost.

• 10+ years of operations, supply chain or manufacturing experience, including at least 7 years in beverage.

• Experience managing products from commercialization through production, distribution, and replenishment.

• Strong experience with co-manufacturers/co-packers, outsourced manufacturing and external supply-chain partners.

• Deep knowledge of production planning, sourcing, ingredients and packaging, inventory, warehousing and transportation.

• Strong financial and operational judgment, including COGS, landed cost, budgets, working capital, vendor negotiation and project management.

• A builder mentality with the ability to move quickly between strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment where the operating infrastructure is being built rapidly.

title: Operations Manager - London Sort Centre
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50-100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.

You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation.

Who will thrive in this role

- Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance

- Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50-100+ operatives

- Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design

- Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land

- Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know

- Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow

- Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote

- Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.

Who you are

- Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.

- Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

- Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

- Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

- Own numbers rather than report them: you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.

- Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About the Position
Dexis Professional Services (Dexis) is seeking a Safety Subject Matter Expert (SME) Consultant to provide advisory support and develop safety plans for complex technical and operational environments. The consultant will apply expertise in occupational safety, hazard assessment, and risk management to establish practical guidance for testing, industrial, and field activities.
Working collaboratively with Dexis teams, the consultant will develop and review safety plans, identify appropriate protective measures, and define requirements for personnel training and occupational health. This role requires strong technical writing skills and the ability to translate complex safety requirements into clear, actionable plans and procedures.
This is a 1099 consultant position. It will be based remotely in the continental United States.
Responsibilities

• Develop and review safety plans aligned with applicable requirements and operational needs.

• Assess work activities to identify hazards, evaluate risks, and recommend appropriate controls and protective measures.

• Establish guidance for incident prevention, reporting and investigation, corrective actions, and emergency response.

• Define safety training, personnel readiness, and occupational health requirements.

• Recommend proactive measures that strengthen safety culture and prevent workplace incidents and injuries.

• Develop practical procedures and program elements to support safety implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.

• 5+ years of experience developing and implementing safety programs for government, DoW, testing, industrial, or field-service operations.

• Demonstrated experience writing contract safety plans, accident prevention plans, or OSHA-compliant safety programs.

• Working knowledge of OSHA, MOSH, NIOSH, ANSI, Army safety requirements, and contractor safety management practices.

• Experience conducting hazard analyses, risk assessments, incident investigations, and corrective-action planning.

• Strong technical writing skills with experience preparing proposal responses and compliance documentation for federal contracts.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Associate Safety Professional (ASP), or Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH).

• Prior experience supporting Army, DoW, test and evaluation, range operations, or Aberdeen Proving Ground programs.

• Quality

• Drive & Passion  

• Agility & Responsiveness  

• Belonging 

• Collaborative Partnerships

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.
Role Overview:
Could you be our next Customer Retention Representative ? Globe Life is looking for a Customer Retention Representative to join the team!
As a Customer Retention Representative, you will play a critical role in maintaining Globe Life's customer base by engaging with policyholders who are considering cancellation or have policies in a lapsed status. This role focuses on building relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing solutions to retain valuable life insurance coverage.
This remote position offers a schedule Monday through Friday.
What You Will Do:

•
Inbound Cancellation Support: Handle incoming calls from policyholders requesting policy cancellations, working to understand their concerns and explore retention options.

•
Outbound Lapse Recovery: Proactively contact customers with lapsed life insurance policies to discuss opportunities and payment solutions.

•
Customer Consultation: Assess individual policyholder situations and recommend appropriate coverage adjustments.

•
Relationship Building: Demonstrate clear, empathetic, and professional communication by actively listening to policy holder concerns, asking clarification questions to fully understand their situation, and explaining policy options and solutions in simple, easy-to-understand language.

•
Documentation: Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions, retention efforts, and outcomes in company systems.

•
Product Knowledge: Stay current on life insurance products, policy features, and company procedures to provide accurate information.

•
Communication: Adapt communication style to meet individual customer needs, maintain a calm and supportive tone during difficult conversations, and ensure all the information provided is accurate and complete. Follow up with customers as needed to confirm understanding and satisfaction with proposed solutions.

•
Performance Metrics and KPI Achievement: Meet or exceed established contact center key performance indicators (KPIs) including call volume targets, retention rate goals, first call resolution, adherence targets, call quality targets, and attendance expectations. Efficiently manage daily call quotas for both inbound cancellation calls and outbound lapse recovery contacts while maintaining quality standards.

​
What You Can Bring:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Basic Microsoft Office Skills, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

• Minimum Typing speed of 30 wpm.

• Experience in a call center environment preferred.

• Some insurance and/or sales experience preferred.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to solve complex policyholder issues with a positive attitude.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and work well under pressure.

• Knowledge of life and/or health insurance terminology preferred.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

• Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

• Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:
Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

• Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

• Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

title: Telehealth Mental Health Provider (Pennsylvania)
description:
Description
MEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, 1099 contractor opportunity offering flexibility, strong patient demand, and a highly supported clinical environment.
At MEDvidi , we provide comprehensive mental health evaluations and treatment for adult patients experiencing conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and mild-to-moderate OCD.
We’re reimagining how care is delivered. Here’s what sets us apart:

•
Full administrative support - no need to hire or manage staff; dedicated assistants handle scheduling, patient communication, and logistics

•
Streamlined technology - proprietary EMR with integrated PDMP and e-prescribing tools

•
Reduced administrative burden - automated workflows and AI-supported documentation tools

•
No software costs - our platform is fully provided at no cost to you

•
Low no-show rates - consistent patient flow and reliable earnings

•
Flexible scheduling - build your own schedule with the ability to increase volume over time

Compensation:
This is a 1099 contractor role with payment per completed appointment:

• Physicians (MD/DO):

• Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$60 per visit

• Follow-ups (15 min): ~$40 per visit

• Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs):

• Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$45 per visit

• Follow-ups (15 min): ~$30 per visit

Consistent availability and schedule optimization can significantly increase total earnings.
At MEDvidi , our mission is to make mental health care more accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. We leverage technology, clinical expertise, and operational support to empower providers and improve patient outcomes across the U.S.
Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations via telehealth

• Review patient medical history, symptoms, medications, and relevant background

• Diagnose and treat conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and OCD

• Develop and implement individualized treatment plans

• Prescribe medications, including controlled substances, in accordance with clinical and regulatory guidelines

• Provide patient education on treatment plans, medication usage, and follow-up care

• Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation in the EMR

• Ensure completion of chart notes and prescriptions within required timeframes

• Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to support patient care and continuity

Requirements

• Board Certified Physician (MD/DO) or Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)

• Active and unrestricted medical license (multi-state preferred)

• Active DEA registration

• Minimum 2 years of clinical experience in mental health treatment

• Experience prescribing controlled substances

• Strong clinical judgment and comfort managing common outpatient psychiatric conditions

• Ability to work a minimum of ~15 hours per week (preferred for patient continuity)

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement
MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d) – Conversational & Agentic AI
description: Dein Impact Du gestaltest für eine Zukunft, in der Menschen seltener Apps öffnen und der Agent sie dort erreicht, wo sie gerade sind: im Chat, per Messenger, Mail, Sprache oder Benachrichtigung. Gestaltet wird das Erlebnis über alle Kanäle, nicht über einzelne Screens. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen eine agentische KI erleben, die sie durch ihr Arbeitsleben begleitet und dabei unterstützt, souverän über ihre Karriere zu entscheiden. Dazu gehört, dass sich ein System, das in ihrem Auftrag handelt, nachvollziehbar, vertrauenswürdig und leicht bedienbar anfühlt. Du entscheidest mit, was wir bauen, nicht nur, wie es aussieht. Neue Fähigkeiten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Product von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Konzept. Du verantwortest den Bereich Design & UX und legst das Fundament für ein wachsendes Produkt: Prinzipien, Design System, Informationsarchitektur und eine Arbeitsweise, die mitwächst. So arbeiten wir Wir bauen agentische KI nicht nur als Produkt, wir arbeiten auch selbst damit. In unserem agentengestützten Entwicklungsprozess wird aus Konzepten in kurzer Zeit lauffähiger Code, mit automatisierten Reviews und Tests in jeder Phase. Für dich heißt das: Zwischen deinem Entwurf und dem fertigen Feature liegen Tage, nicht Monate. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entwicklung und KI-Agenten zusammen, testest Ideen am echten Produkt statt am Klickdummy und entwickelst die Art, wie Design und Engineering bei uns zusammenarbeiten, aktiv weiter. Deine Aufgaben Produkt & Konzeption: Du übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse und Geschäftsziele in Produktkonzepte. Du entwickelst User Journeys, Story Maps und Feature-Konzepte und bringst sie mit Product, AI-Team und Engineering zur Entscheidungsreife. title: Co-op, Mechatronics Engineer
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is seeking a Co-op, Mechatronics Engineer to join the Hardware & Controls Engineering team in Alewife for the January through May term. You will work on the systems that make autonomous science possible: automated workcells, custom instrumentation, sensing hardware, motion systems, and integrated lab equipment.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to build real hardware in a fast-moving R&D environment. You will move between mechanical design, electrical integration, prototyping, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, working alongside engineers and scientists to turn lab needs into reliable engineering systems.

Your work will support the next generation of lab automation at Lila, helping improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of systems used across our scientific programs. You will leave the term with practical experience across the full mechatronics stack, from concept and CAD through build, test, and iteration.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and build mechanical and electromechanical components for automated lab systems.

• Support integration of sensors, actuators, motion systems, and control hardware.

• Create CAD models, drawings, prototypes, fixtures, and test setups.

• Assemble, debug, and iterate on hardware for workcells and custom instrumentation.

• Run tests, document results, and communicate design changes clearly.

• Collaborate with engineers and scientists to translate lab workflows into reliable systems.

• Contribute to improvements that increase system reliability, usability, and maintainability.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

• Experience with CAD design, prototyping, fabrication, or hands-on engineering projects.

• Foundational understanding of mechanical systems, electrical systems, sensors, actuators, or controls.

• Comfortable building, testing, debugging, and documenting physical systems.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in hands-on technical work.

• Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering and scientific teams.

• Curiosity about lab automation, instrumentation, robotics, or autonomous science.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with SolidWorks or another parametric CAD tool.

• Exposure to electrical wiring, instrumentation, controls, or data acquisition systems.

• Experience with robotics, lab automation, industrial automation, or motion systems.

• Familiarity with 3D printing, machining, sheet metal, or rapid prototyping methods.

• Previous internship, co-op, lab, project team, or R&D experience.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

Senior Counsel, Commercial Role 
 
At Deploy, our Legal Team is dedicated to providing expert legal advice in a fast-paced startup environment. As Senior Counsel, Commercial you will be a crucial member of Deploy’s legal team and will report to our General Counsel. ABOUT OPTEXITY

Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models on data no other lab can reach. We deploy directly inside clinics and hospitals - including systems with no APIs, using integration infrastructure we've built and open-sourced - and in return become their preferred partner. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them.

We're a small, fast-moving founding team with multiple published papers in NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR etc and background from Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, CMU, IIT.

We are backed by world-class investors and leaders like Jeff Dean, Neotribe VC, PearVC, Together Fund and Zapier Fund.

 

HOW WE WORK

- Customer obsession - we start with the customer and work backwards

- Intellectual honesty - ideas matter more than titles; we communicate directly and assume good intent, even in disagreement

- Bias for action - we build and learn with customers rather than debate in the abstract

- Extreme ownership - we own outcomes, not just tasks, and see problems through

About the role

This is not a support role, and not a sales role. It is a flexible, hands-on role for someone who wants to start a company one day. You will be the face of Optexity to our customers: the practices, clinics and doctors who use our product every day. You will sit with them on site, learn how they work, and bring what you learn back to the founders to shape the product. In one role you get product, customer discovery, customer success, customer coordination and a taste of engineering.

This role is on site in New York, where all of our customers are.

What you’ll do

- Work directly with doctors, practice managers and clinic staff to understand their workflows and pain points

- Run customer discovery: gather requirements, spot patterns across practices, and turn them into clear product priorities

- Help design the product with the founders and engineers, and test new features with customers

- Onboard new practices: coordinate setup, access, integrations and training

- Drive usage: track adoption, find out why users stall, and get more doctors using the product more often

- Be the single point of contact for customers, and close the loop on every issue and request

- Work with engineers to debug problems, write specs, and ship small fixes yourself where you can

- Help with early sales and renewals by building trust and relationships with practices

Ideal candidate

- Genuinely wants to start a company someday and wants a front-row seat

- Strong communicator who is comfortable talking with doctors and busy clinic staff

- Highly organized, follows through, and closes loops

- Energized by ambiguity and takes ownership without needing to be guided

- Based in New York, or willing to move, and comfortable being on site with customers most days

- Comfortable with technology, and curious about how software gets built

- New Grads welcome to apply

Nice to have

- Prior experience in customer success, consulting, startups, product or operations

- Familiarity with healthcare, practice operations or EMR systems

- Basic technical skills such as SQL, scripting or working with APIs

- Prior founder or founding team experience

What you get

- Direct, daily work with the founders, plus exposure to board and investor conversations

- A broad view of product, customers, sales and engineering that few roles offer

- Real ownership, with scope that grows as the company does

- Support on your path to starting your own company

- Competitive salary

title: Field Product Quality Engineer - Altius
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Field Product Quality Engineering team operates at the intersection of flight operations and mission success for Anduril’s autonomous aerial systems. We ensure that every anomaly, failure, and performance trend is captured in real time and driven to root cause resolution-so that each flight makes the next one more reliable.

This is a field-forward role. You will be on-site at launch and recovery locations, working shoulder-to-shoulder with flight crews, systems engineers, and program leadership to close the loop between what happens in the air and what gets fixed on the ground.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Flight Operations Quality Data Collection

• Work under minimal supervision with responsibilities for test planning, execution, reporting, and evaluation of the aircraft system under test (software and/or hardware).

• Manage all field configuration changes-hardware, software, and as-shipped main box contents. Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Mission Performance, Design, Software, and Configuration Management to maintain clear as-built records in support of root cause corrective actions and customer complaints.

• Develop and maintain standardized field data collection protocols, checklists, and digital forms that ensure consistent, high-fidelity quality records across all flight events and operational sites.

• Perform real-time quality observation during launch sequences, in-flight operations, and post-flight recovery-identifying workmanship issues, procedural deviations, configuration discrepancies, and environmental factors that may affect flight performance or vehicle integrity.

• Establish, track, and analyze key quality metrics-first-flight success rate, recurring anomaly trends, pre-flight escape rate, and mean time between failures-to provide the product team with actionable reliability data.

Flight Failure Investigation & Corrective Action

• Own the end-to-end coordination of all flight failures-from initial data collection and evidence preservation through root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification. Initiate rapid “In the Field” 8D analysis to establish quick wins that enable return to flight.

• Lead cross-functional failure review boards with flight operations, systems engineering, manufacturing, and reliability engineering to determine root cause using structured methodologies (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree Analysis).

• Coordinate rapid containment actions following flight anomalies, including fleet-wide inspections, hold/release decisions, and risk assessments to determine return-to-flight readiness.

• Monitor a flight failure tracking system with full traceability from symptom to root cause to corrective action closure; generate trend reports and lessons-learned summaries for program leadership.

• Interface with design engineering and upstream manufacturing/supplier quality to translate field failure findings into actionable design changes, drawing updates, supplier corrective actions (SCARs), and process improvements that prevent recurrence across the fleet.

Product Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities for field-discovered nonconformances, providing disposition recommendations inf

title: Transplant Coordinator

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
At LifeNet Health , as the Transplant Coordinator , you will make an impact by leveraging your expertise, collaboration, and commitment to excellence to help advance our mission of Saving Lives, Restoring Health, and Giving Hope. Through your daily work, you will contribute to innovative solutions, operational excellence, and meaningful outcomes that support donors, patients, healthcare providers, and our communities. Whether driving strategic initiatives, improving processes, supporting customers, advancing research, developing talent, or ensuring quality and compliance, your contributions will help strengthen our ability to transform lives and shape the future of regenerative medicine.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

PARTNER EXCELLENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

- Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

- A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

- Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

- Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial cri

title: Admissions Writing Coach / Essay Editor
description:
About Jack Westin

Jack Westin is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials. The MCAT tests students on the scientific reasoning skills and scientific knowledge which can be learned during typical undergraduate coursework.

Our Three Principles

As we continue to grow and help students, we are guided by three major principles that we believe are vital to our community.

Attention to quality

We only create courses and practice questions that we would use. That means having the best, first-class teaching content that can possibly exist. We're not satisfied with mediocrity. We don't care about the amount of time or money it takes to get something done right. If it's not perfect, we won't stop until we believe it is. This ethos runs deep within our company.

Excellence in support

We're obsessed with our students. Their well-being and success drives us each day. Great customer service is not an afterthought. It is the most important service we can offer. We understand that our students come from different learning backgrounds. It's our mission to ensure that each one has an amazing experience.

Learn from anywhere at anytime

We are committed to building the future of education on the internet so that it is easily accessible to all students from around the world. Our dedication is to all students who want to learn, regardless of their pace, and no matter what time of the day it is.

Admissions Writing Coach / Essay Editor(Remote, Part-Time)

The Admissions Writing Coach is the first expert to work with each student's application materials, helping them turn ordinary drafts into compelling, admissions-committee-ready essays. This role goes well beyond proofreading: coaches strengthen prompt alignment, content, structure, and language while keeping every essay unmistakably the student's own. Coaches work closely with Jack Westin 's admissions experts, who hold final say and conduct the last round of review before each submission returns to the student.

Responsibilities

• Coach students through personal statements, AMCAS/AACOMAS/TMDSAS activities, most meaningful experiences, secondary essays, MD/PhD essays, letters of intent, and other admissions materials

• Provide detailed, substantive feedback on prompt alignment, content, structure, and language, the way a thoughtful admissions committee member would

• Model strong writing without writing for the student: draft illustrative examples tailored to the student's real background, then guide them to rewrite in their own words

• Research relevant details (programs, diagnoses, clinical settings) so guidance and examples are specific and grounded

• Leave a small number of focused margin notes that explain your reasoning and point the student toward their next step

• Protect the student's authentic voice at every stage of the process

• Lead brainstorming and strategy sessions with students, while the assigned admissions expert remains their primary point of contact

• Flag anything needing expert judgment with clear, actionable notes, and document your reasoning so guidance stays consistent across the team

• Contribute to educational resources, training materials, and admissions content, and participate in coach training and quality reviews

• Meet established turnaround times and quality benchmarks

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Communications, or a related field (Premium Admissions Level)

• At least 5 years of professional editing, writing, teaching, publishing, or journalism experience and/or a creative writing certification (Signature Admissions Level)

• Exceptional writing, developmental feedback, and coaching skills, with strong command of grammar, style, and mechanics

• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

• Experience coaching or editing medical school admissions materials preferred

• Familiarity with AMC

title: Product Manager | Bill Pay
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Every business pays bills, and many of them still do it by hand. Someone opens the invoice, types it in, codes it, chases approvals, pays it, matches it and syncs it to the books. It's one of the largest manual workflows left in finance.

We're building the version where software does that work. Bills come in and get read, coded, matched, approved and paid, and a person steps in only when judgment matters. Bill Pay is already one of Ramp's fastest-growing products. The next few years decide who owns AP for the next decade, and we plan for it to be us.

We're looking for a PM who wants to build that.

- Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders - und besser - gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

title: Senior Site Reliaiblity Engineer
description:
Overview
Define what reliability means for a GPU-accelerated AI platform and make it measurable. You will own the service-level indicators and objectives for the K0rdent Observability Framework (KOF) - deriving meaningful SLIs from the signals the platform already emits, and exposing them to Platform Administrators through a clean API. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.
About the Role
We are looking for a senior SRE who thinks past dashboards to the contract between a platform and its operators. The right candidate can look at raw telemetry from Kubernetes, bare metal, and NVIDIA infrastructure, decide which signals actually predict user-visible reliability, and turn them into SLIs and SLOs that operators can act on. You are equally comfortable writing the service that exposes those SLIs through an API and reasoning about error budgets, alerting quality, and signal-to-noise. You should be self-directed, able to own reliability definitions end to end, and effectively communicate them across teams.
Responsibilities

• Define SLIs and SLOs based on the signals available across the platform - Kubernetes, bare-metal hosts, and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

• Design and build the API that exposes SLIs and reliability state to Platform Administrators and downstream systems.

• Establish alerting and error-budget practices that maximize signal and minimize noise.

• Partner with infrastructure, storage, and networking teams to ensure the right signals are instrumented and collected.

• Diagnose reliability and performance issues across the observability stack and drive their resolution.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in SRE, platform reliability, or a closely related software/infrastructure role.

• Strong software engineering skills (e.g., Go or Python) with experience building and operating APIs or services in production.

• Demonstrated experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for real production systems.

• Hands-on experience with observability tooling - metrics, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

• Solid understanding of Kubernetes and the signals it and its workloads emit.

• Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

• Experience instrumenting or monitoring bare-metal and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC/Redfish, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

• Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, KOF) and Cluster API.

• Familiarity with VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs at scale.

• Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises

• Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence

• Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success
